title: C.D. Jackson visits Betty and Barney Hill
summary: Jesse Michels tells of C.D. Jackson visits Betty and Barney Hill, about 1961 at New Hampshire, US, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh uh he showed up uh at Betty and Barney Hills house two weeks after they encountered what they encountered.

plain: Betty and Barney Hill were a couple in New Hampshire who reported a strange encounter in 1961. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named C.D. Jackson turned up at their house just two weeks after it happened. If true, it would suggest someone with connections was quietly taking an interest in their story very early on.
